entries.a0b33fbf5939317d: As its corporate philosophy, it sets out its basic philosophy, "Profit lies in the shadow of people's joy," and its store philosophy, "Creating stores that last 100 years." In its Long-Term Management Concept 2035, it sets as its aim "Engaging in diverse food business formats, building enduring companies and brands, and producing smiles, excitement, and happy times for everyone," and sets priority measures as "improvement of profitability" and "strengthening human resource capabilities and enhancing the on-site environment."
